Note the reported surviving mutant (hostname localhost passes with stub resolver) and judge whether it is an acceptable gap (UrlValidator has its own tests). Remove throwaways and verify `git status --porcelain lib/ test/ scripts/` in context.worktree is clean (new test is already committed). Also run `mix format --check-formatted` on the test file. Modify nothing but this handoff. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim, then COMPLETED/FAILED with result.status PASS/FAIL; next_action 'Route to TEST-RUNNER' on PASS. NOTE: the full `mix letflow.check.test` is heavy (16 partitions, exhausted Postgres connections in the previous step) - do NOT run it; TEST-RUNNER owns that.
